properties.Custom Text: [{"table_name": "my_table", "table_upper": "MY_TABLE", "staging_table": "MY_TABLE_STAGING", "src_cols": "id,name,updated_at", "src_col_count": 3, "merge_sql": "MERGE INTO MY_DB.MY_SCHEMA.MY_TABLE T USING (SELECT * FROM MY_DB.MY_SCHEMA.MY_TABLE_STAGING QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ID ORDER BY _LOADED_AT DESC) = 1) S ON T.ID = S.ID WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET T.NAME = S.NAME, T.UPDATED_AT = S.UPDATED_AT, T._LOADED_AT = S._LOADED_AT WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (ID, NAME, UPDATED_AT, _LOADED_AT) VALUES (S.ID, S.NAME, S.UPDATED_AT, S._LOADED_AT)", "truncate_sql": "TRUNCATE TABLE MY_DB.MY_SCHEMA.MY_TABLE_STAGING", "channel_prefix": "mysql_my_table"}]
